entities.name: Linden & Rye
entities.summary: Neighbourhood café and bakery on Alder Street, open nine years, raising prices on 2 March due to rising costs; run by Tomás and Hanna.

entities.name: Regulars of Linden & Rye
entities.summary: Long-time customers, some since the café's first week, who formed relationships and history there; their reaction to the price rise and neighbour card is the central question.

entities.name: Tomás
entities.summary: Co-owner of Linden & Rye who signed the price-change notice and will host the open evening to listen to customers.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.summary: Co-owner of Linden & Rye who signed the price-change notice and will host the open evening to listen to customers.

entities.name: Linden & Rye team
entities.summary: Café staff whose pay was raised to at least €15/hour last spring and who will now get two days off together from April.

entities.name: Price increase (2 March)
entities.summary: New prices for coffee, bread and lunch items taking effect Monday 2 March, driven by rising costs of butter, flour, coffee beans and rent.

entities.name: Neighbour card
entities.summary: New €12/month subscription offering one free filter coffee every day, aimed at making daily visits cheaper for regulars.

entities.name: Filter coffee
entities.summary: Café drink whose price rises from €2.40 to €2.90; refills remain free and it is included daily in the neighbour card.

entities.name: Flat white
entities.summary: Café drink whose price rises from €3.60 to €4.20.

entities.name: Sourdough loaf
entities.summary: Bakery item whose price rises from €5.50 to €6.80.

entities.name: Cinnamon bun
entities.summary: Bakery item whose price rises from €3.20 to €3.90.

entities.name: Lunch soup with bread
entities.summary: Lunch item whose price rises from €7.50 to €8.90.

entities.name: Pay-it-forward board
entities.summary: Existing café practice letting customers buy coffee for someone in need; explicitly kept unchanged despite price rise.

entities.name: Tuesday closure
entities.summary: New policy from April closing the café on Tuesdays in addition to Mondays, to give the small team two days off together.

entities.name: Open evening (26 February)
entities.summary: Café event on Thursday 26 February at 7pm where owners will answer customer questions about the price changes over free buns.

entities.name: Instagram account of Linden & Rye
entities.summary: Social media channel where the café posted its note about price changes, alongside posting it on the café window.
